about_the_game:
A nature-focused exploration game where you can immerse yourself in the magical beauty of the forest.

Discover a variety of lush woodland environments and collect as many rare mushrooms as you can. Watch wildlife, enjoy the rich sights and ambient sounds of the wilderness, and uncover hidden surprises along the way.

While peaceful for the most part, nature can sometimes surprise you — but the real reward is the journey itself.

-----------------------------------------------

  • Explore diverse forest environments filled with life and detail.

  • Collect rare mushrooms hidden across the wilderness.

  • Observe animals in their natural habitat.

  • Relax to the peaceful sights and ambient sounds of nature.

  • Discover hidden surprises along the way.

  • A calm and immersive experience — but nature may still surprise you.

[Expect regular free DLCs and content updates for the game.]

-------------------------------

[(-->Mushroom picking in real life carries great responsibility. This game is only a simulation. If you wish to collect mushrooms, please consult an inspector or a qualified specialist!<--)]

-------------------------------

Compatible with NVIDIA graphics cards I RTX-DLAA !!

-------------------------------
